source: User-supplied Gemini 4K batch; downloaded results verified against the original batch SHA-256 records.
reviewMethod: Visual inspection of all 252 concepts and six references on 15 labeled contact boards; direct original/Gemini comparison of the three lowest normalized-luminance-similarity scenes. Automated resolution, checksum, exact-duplicate, activity and similarity triage supports the inspection; numeric similarity is not an aesthetic approval. All previous sloped-geometry exceptions were rechecked; four native scenes were retained per user instruction.
fidelityCaveat: Normalized luminance similarity only flags composition/tonal differences. It neither guarantees unchanged fine details nor assigns design quality.
